characterList.description: A young woman with bright orange dreadlocks, multiple tattoos including a tiger on her shirt, and a nose piercing.
characterList.name: Victoria Rose

content_metadata.description: A personal vlog documenting Victoria's journey to Egypt, highlighting the challenges and rewards of solo travel in a post-pandemic world.

qAndA.question: What type of COVID test did Victoria initially get that wasn't accepted?

qAndA.answer: People were smoking inside the airport.
qAndA.question: What was unusual about the airport in Cairo that surprised Victoria?

qAndA.answer: Boxed meals with bread, cheese, dessert, and orange juice. There were no vegetarian options.
qAndA.question: What kind of food did Egypt Air provide on the flight?
What was misplaced because Victoria was the only international flyer on her flight?

qAndA.answer: She needed proof of an outgoing flight from Egypt to be allowed to check in to her original flight.
qAndA.question: Why did Victoria have to book a flight to Turkey?
